fields.statement: QA at c7b756f9 with the built binary (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) in a scratch repo with a bare origin and a fake gh (Actions run 42, apt-mirror log, no failing test); clock moved by hand through RHIZA_TEST_NOW, each call a fresh process. ship check --infra: exit 1 with no red recorded; after --settled spent the head's one rerun and ship check recorded the red, --infra exit 0 and --test-failures exit 1. --settled --changed --rerun-infra: at red_at+4m not settled, naming the infra failure and next rerun at red_at+5m, no rerun; past it it ran gh run rerun 42 --failed (rerun 1) with next at +10m; reruns then fell at 10m, 20m, 30m, 30m after the previous one (state file red_at, infra_reruns 5, infra_rerun_at), with each new failed job ID (10..13) still not settled. An IN_PROGRESS attempt was not settled; a SUCCESS attempt settled (exit 0) and plain ship check passed and cleared red_at/infra_* from the state. On a new head: an attempt red with --- FAIL: TestGarden in its log settled the wait (exit 0), and --infra then failed with 'the red head has failing tests'. A push of another head mid-wait settled past the red head (new head's CI got its own rerun). A new red head reset red_at. Scoped tests TestShipCheckInfra and TestShipCheckRerunInfraBackoff pass. Nits: the rerun note omits the run ID ('reran the failed jobs of run (rerun 1)', ship.go:971), and a passing --infra prints only '.'.

QA at c7b756f9 with the built binary: rhiza workflow check plan and plan-milestone are valid (builtin); workflow describe for both shows pr-green on.fail -> pr-green-infra (rhiza ship check --infra) on.pass -> pr-green-infra-wait on.pass -> pr-green, and the same for rebased-green. The wait's until (--settled --changed --rerun-infra) was driven by hand against a fake gh (see ship-check-infra-rerun-backoff-qa-1). go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... and the plan-workflow-ci testscripts (infra-wait, infra-timeout, flake-red) pass.

QA at c7b756f9 with the built binary: rhiza workflow check ship-change is valid; describe shows ci-triage on.fail -> wait-ci-rerun, whose until is rhiza ship check --settled --changed --rerun-infra; that command, run by hand against a fake gh with an infra red, reran run 42's failed jobs itself on a 5/10/20/30/30m backoff and settled once a rerun went green. Testscripts run-ship-infra-wait and run-ship-rerun-fail pass.

QA at c7b756f9 with the built binary: workflow describe ship-change shows rebase-merge-gate-failed on.fail -> landed-infra-triage (rhiza ship check --infra) on.pass -> landed-infra-wait (--settled --changed --rerun-infra) on.pass -> landed-green. Hand runs of both commands against a fake gh: --infra passes only on a recorded infra red and fails on a red with a failing test or none recorded; the wait reruns with backoff and settles on green. Testscript run-ship-landed-infra-wait passes.
